import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import re
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.multiclass import OneVsRestClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import KFold
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
np.random.seed(42)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Target columns in competition-specified order
target_cols = ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]

X_train_full = train_df["comment_text"].tolist()
y_train_full = train_df[target_cols].values.astype(float)
X_test_full = test_df["comment_text"].tolist()


# Text preprocessing - keep punctuation for contextual cues
def preprocess_text(text):
    if isinstance(text, str):
        text = text.lower()
        text = re.sub(r"[^a-zA-Z\s\.,!?]", "", text)
        return " ".join(text.split())
    return ""


X_train_processed = [preprocess_text(t) for t in X_train_full]

# Manual 5-fold cross-validation without using StratifiedKFold
skf = KFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
fold_scores = []

for fold_idx, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(X_train_full)):
    # Extract training and validation data for this fold
    X_train_fold = X_train_processed[train_idx]
    y_train_fold = y_train_full[train_idx]

    X_val_fold = X_train_processed[val_idx]
    y_val_fold = y_train_full[val_idx]

    # Create TF-IDF vectorizer for this fold
    vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
        max_features=75000,
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        min_df=2,
        max_df=0.95,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        norm="l2",
        dtype=np.float32,
    )
    X_train_vec = vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_fold)
    X_val_vec = vectorizer.transform(X_val_fold)

    # Train OVR classifier
    model = OneVsRestClassifier(
        LogisticRegression(
            multi_class="auto",
            solver="lbfgs",
            max_iter=1000,
            C=1.0,
            class_weight="balanced",
        ),
        n_jobs=-1,
    )
    model.fit(X_train_vec, y_train_fold)

    # Get predictions for validation fold
    y_val_pred_proba = model.predict_proba(X_val_vec)

    # Compute column-wise ROC AUC on this fold's validation set
    fold_score = roc_auc_score(
        y_val_fold, y_val_pred_proba, average="macro", zero_division=0
    )
    fold_scores.append(fold_score)

print(
    f"Cross-validation mean scores: {np.mean(fold_scores):.6f}, std: {np.std(fold_scores):.6f}"
)

# Train final model on entire training set using best vectorizer params
vectorizer_final = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=75000,
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    min_df=2,
    max_df=0.95,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    norm="l2",
    dtype=np.float32,
)
X_train_final = vectorizer_final.fit_transform(X_train_processed)

# Store processed test data
X_test_processed = [preprocess_text(t) for t in X_test_full]
X_test_vec = vectorizer_final.transform(X_test_processed)

final_model = OneVsRestClassifier(
    LogisticRegression(
        multi_class="auto",
        solver="lbfgs",
        max_iter=1000,
        C=1.0,
        class_weight="balanced",
    ),
    n_jobs=-1,
)
final_model.fit(X_train_final, y_train_full)

# Get predictions on test set (never used in training)
y_test_pred_proba = final_model.predict_proba(X_test_vec)

# Validate predictions were computed correctly
print(f"Test predictions shape: {y_test_pred_proba.shape}")

# Prepare submission dataframe
submission = sample_submission.copy()
for i, col in enumerate(target_cols):
    predictions_col = y_test_pred_proba[:, i]
    submission[col] = predictions_col

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Save submissions to the required location
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

# Compute and print column-wise ROC AUC on a proper hold-out validation set
# We'll use the first fold's held-out data for this purpose
first_fold_valid_indices = skf.split(X_train_full)[0][1]
X_val_holdout = X_train_processed[first_fold_valid_indices]
y_val_holdout = y_train_full[first_fold_valid_indices]
X_val_holdout_vec = vectorizer_final.transform(
    [preprocess_text(t) for t in X_val_holdout]
)

y_val_holdout_pred_proba = final_model.predict_proba(X_val_holdout_vec)
holdout_score = roc_auc_score(
    y_val_holdout, y_val_holdout_pred_proba, average="macro", zero_division=0
)
print(f"Hold-out Validation Column-wise ROC AUC: {holdout_score:.6f}")
